title: Anne Meixner and Laura Peters
gist: Not an article: this is the Semiconductor Engineering author archive page for Anne Meixner and Laura Peters, showing only a truncated teaser of 'Shift Left Complicates Fab Data Management'. The only extractable content is the teaser's key takeaways on fabs moving detection into process modules using real-time sensor data and AI/ML.

insights.claim: Fabs are using real-time equipment sensor data and AI/ML to identify process excursions inside the process module and improve advanced process control, moving yield detection earlier.
insights.speaker: Semiconductor Engineering
insights.so_what: In-situ fab analytics is a growth area for yield-management and APC software.
insights.quote: Fabs are using real-time equipment sensor data and AI/ML to identify process excursions inside the process module and improve advanced process control.

insights.claim: Higher sampling rates, hundreds of sensor parameters and sub-second analysis are increasing the volume, velocity and variety of manufacturing data.
insights.speaker: Semiconductor Engineering
insights.so_what: Rising fab data loads drive demand for data infrastructure and edge analytics.
insights.quote: Higher sampling rates, hundreds of sensor parameters, and sub-second analysis are increasing the volume, velocity, and variety of manufacturing data.

insights.claim: Data context and connectivity remain important in fab analytics, though the teaser is truncated before elaborating on the trade-off.
insights.speaker: Semiconductor Engineering
insights.so_what: Signals the tension between per-module optimization and cross-fab data context.
